content: <thought>Based on the mass (M⁺ = 224.12 Da, corresponding to C₁₆H₁₆O), the ¹³C NMR (carbonyl ~197 ppm, 12 aromatic carbons, three aliphatic carbons) and the ¹H NMR (acetyl methyl singlet, two equivalent CH₂ triplets, 9 aromatic protons), the structure is a para‑substituted acetophenone bearing a phenylethyl group.
